name: Io Whitespirit
original_name: イオ・ホワイトスピリット
source:
"Then, I will go."

A white spirit, something extremely rare on the entire continent.

She fights to protect those important to her. She doesn't have much experience in battle, but she has much latent potential.

She really isn't fond of fighting.
